terra.problem: “Wrong recipe card” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The comparison has dough rising while the floodwaters recede. The actions run in opposite directions.
The passage says where the ark came to rest, not that it never came anywhere near Samaria.
The text does not say there had been nothing but water to see for months, or that these were the first or highest pieces of land to appear.
“No towers yet” asserts something the passage does not establish.
The waters had been receding before Noah sent out the raven. The text does not say it flew back and forth for the whole time they were drying.
The dove found no place to rest her foot. That does not establish that there was nowhere to build anything.
“Wrong tree” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
John 12:13 says the crowd took palm branches and went out to meet Jesus; it does not say they waved them.
A freshly plucked leaf does not establish that something had started growing again.
The little leaf with a big message repeats the same line and idea from card 15, answer 1.
The explanation is flat and generic: it restates the answer and calls it news without adding much personality or explanation.
The passage does not say the ark’s door was open when God told Noah to come out.
